💡 chegou | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Quick and easy file sharing between a computer and a mobile device without the need for external apps or cloud services, primarily for local network transfers.
✨ Key Features: • Send and receive files, photos, videos, text, and links between PC and phone • Operates over local network (LAN) or via Cloudflare tunnel for cross-network access • No phone app installation required, disposable connection • Secure transfer with a token-based QR code • File dropping directly onto the terminal window
📖 Summary: Chegou is a command-line tool that enables seamless file transfer between a PC and a phone over a local network or via a Cloudflare tunnel. It requires no phone installation and operates with a simple QR code scan.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 ember-p2p | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a decentralized, censorship-resistant social networking platform where users control their data and interactions without relying on central servers or algorithms.
✨ Key Features: • Serverless social network • No accounts, no central authority • Identity based on keypairs • Content replication by followers • Discovery via locality-sensitive hashing (LSH) and topic rooms
📖 Summary: Ember is a decentralized social network built on peer-to-peer technology, eliminating the need for central servers, accounts, or algorithms. It uses a keypair for identity and relies on users re-sharing content to keep it alive, with discovery based on topic proximity rather than popularity.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 ProxyBridge | C
🎯 Primary Use Case: To transparently route application network traffic through HTTP or SOCKS5 proxies on Windows, macOS, and Linux, offering an alternative to existing proxifier tools.
✨ Key Features: • Transparent proxy routing for TCP and UDP traffic • Supports SOCKS5 and HTTP proxies • Per-application traffic control (route, block, allow) • System-level operation, compatible with proxy-unaware applications
📖 Summary: ProxyBridge is a universal proxy client for Windows, macOS, and Linux that acts as a Proxifier alternative. It enables transparent routing of TCP and UDP traffic from applications through SOCKS5 or HTTP proxies, allowing granular control over traffic flow on a per-application basis.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ phoneinfoga | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: Information gathering and OSINT investigation on phone numbers.
✨ Key Features: • Check if phone number exists • Gather basic information (country, line type, carrier) • OSINT footprinting using external APIs, phone books & search engines • Check for reputation reports, social media, disposable numbers • Graphical user interface
📖 Summary: PhoneInfoga is an advanced Go-based framework for gathering information about phone numbers. It collects basic details like country, carrier, and line type, and then uses various OSINT techniques, external APIs, and search engines to find potential VoIP providers or identify owners. It also offers a REST API and Go modules for programmatic use.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 Understand-Anything | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To help developers quickly understand and navigate large or unfamiliar codebases by visualizing them as interactive knowledge graphs.
✨ Key Features: • Interactive knowledge graph visualization of codebases • Exploration, search, and querying of code structure • Integration with AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI, etc.)
📖 Summary: Understand Anything transforms codebases into interactive knowledge graphs, allowing developers to explore, search, and understand complex projects more effectively. It integrates with various AI coding assistants to provide a visual overview of code structure and dependencies.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ midday | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide freelancers and solo entrepreneurs with an integrated platform for managing all aspects of their business operations, from tracking time and sending invoices to storing documents and analyzing finances.
✨ Key Features: • Time Tracking • Invoicing (upcoming) • Magic Inbox (invoice/receipt matching) • Vault (secure file storage) • Seamless Export (CSV)
📖 Summary: Midday is an AI-powered business assistant for freelancers and solo entrepreneurs, consolidating invoicing, time tracking, file storage, and financial overview into a single platform. It aims to streamline business operations by automating tasks like invoice matching and providing insightful financial analysis.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
